title: All Things Bright and Beautiful - SATB closed score + piano, 4 pages, hidden choir staves, endings, D.S.

expected.notes: Five parts: Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass (closed score: S+A share the treble staff, T+B the bass staff, bracketed; each shared staff MUST be split into two parts by stem direction) and Piano (braced grand staff, ONE part, never split - its right hand has two voices in the verse, which must stay inside the piano part). Systems 1 (introduction) and 4 (interlude) show only the piano: the choir parts have invisible whole-measure rests there. The verse (mm. 15-23) is repeated: verse 1 and verse 2 are stacked; m.22 = 1st ending (verse 1 "ny wings"), m.23 = 2nd ending (verse 2 "the sky"). Segno m.5, To Coda after m.10, D.S. al Coda after m.23, Coda m.24 - notated order, not unrolled. Lyrics are under both choir staves; truth attaches them to Soprano and Tenor (Alto/Bass sing the same syllables on the same rhythm).

truth_limitations: Lyrics are encoded on Soprano (verses 1-2) and Tenor (copied by onset), not on Alto/Bass. Choir rests in piano-only systems are print-object="no". Beaming not encoded.

title: Old Hundredth - closed SATB, reduced-size descant staff with cue notes, Amen at a smaller staff size

expected.notes: Five parts: Descant, Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass. S+A share the treble staff and T+B the bass staff (closed score - split by stem direction). The Descant staff (75 % size) is hidden in the verse 1-3 systems (truth: invisible measure rests) and appears for verse 4; its first three measures are CUE-SIZE notes of the melody (encoded <cue/>, not sung): a correct conversion marks them as cue notes or omits them (rests) - they must not become sounding Descant notes and carry no lyrics. The hymn is written out twice (verses 1-3, then verse 4 + descant: the last bar of pass 1 and the pickup of pass 2 are both 2-beat measures). The final "Amen" (2 measures) is a separate smaller system (78 % staff size) continuing the S/A/T/B parts; the Descant has invisible rests there. Lyrics: Soprano lines 1-3 in pass 1, line 4 (Doxology) in pass 2, line 1 "A-men"; Descant line 1 from its 4th measure.

truth_limitations: Cue notes are encoded with <cue/> and <type size="cue"> (they have no MIDI meaning). Staff sizes are <staff-details><staff-size> percentages. Stanza labels ("1."-"4.") are not encoded. Lyrics under the S+A staff are attached to Soprano only. The Amen is engraved as a second LilyPond \score; in the truth it simply continues the parts.
layout: US letter, staff size 18; page 1: title + 2 closed-score systems (3 verses); page 2: 2 systems with the 75 % descant staff, then the Amen system at staff size 14
